card.name: Start of names in credits and citations
card.fires_on: The first piece of a split-up surname or title in reviewer lists, investigator lists and reference citations (Ro, Sch, Did, Z). It also fires on 'Adults' at the start of a directions line.

modes.label: Split names in credits
modes.description: The opening piece of a surname or job title that is split into several parts, in investigator, reviewer or author lists.

modes.label: Directions opening
modes.description: The word Adults starting an age-group line after a directions sentence on a product label.
modes.example: DIRECTIONS: Shake well before use.<< Adults>> & children over 12 years old

modes.label: Citation punctuation
modes.description: A comma or domain ending inside a reference entry.
modes.example: Marx J<<,>> et al. Rosen's Emergency Medicine.

card.plain: It fires on the first piece of an unusual surname or title in reviewer and citation lists, and on 'Adults' at the start of label directions.
